en: The Vimānavatthu:
The Mansion of a Man,
from the Pāyāsi Chapter.
4. The First Mansion of the Donor of a Dwelling Just as the moon,
when the clouds have vanished,
moves through the sky illuminating the firmament;
Just like that, this celestial mansion of yours stands illuminating the sky.
You have attained the power of a deva, O one of great majesty.
"What merit did you perform while being a human being?
By what means have you come to possess such blazing majesty,
and why does your complexion illuminate all directions?"
Thus the young deva was delighted...
[as before] ...the fruit of which action this is.
“Both I and my wife, in the world of men,
gave a dwelling place to the Arahant;
with hearts full of faith, we offered food and drink.”
We gave abundant gifts with due respect.
Because of that, my complexion is such as this... [and so forth]...
"And my radiance shines in all directions.
Thus ends the fourth *Vimāna*, the First Mansion of the Donor of the Hermitage.
